title: TesseraQL Simple YAML v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL Simple YAML documents: routes (web/**/<method>.yml), jobs (batch/**/job.yml), queue consumers (consume/**), and declarative views (*.view.yml).
$comment: additionalProperties stays true so newer keys never break older editors; the route recipe enum is kept in sync with the linter by a build-time test.

id.description: Unique document id, e.g. products.page; referenced by tests, coverage, governance approvals, and logs.

kind.description: route/job/view (this schema's shapes), workflow/scope/attachment (their own trees), and the mcp/ kinds tool/resource/ui/prompt, which reuse the route model.

recipe.description: What the route does: query-json/command-json (JSON APIs), query-html/page (HTML pages), query-export/file-import/file-export (file transfers), webhook (inbound webhooks), queue-consume (consume/** documents), and the job recipes batch-tasklet/batch-pipeline.

input.description: Declared input fields - one contract for routes and jobs alike (a job's parameters bind and validate exactly like a route's). Documented in input-binding.md and jobs.md.

inputPolicy.description: Route-level input handling policy (e.g. unknown-field behavior) layered over the deny-by-default input: contract.

auth.description: bearer | browser | api-key | mtls | public (deny-by-default: no auth means no access to protected data).

csrf.description: CSRF posture: auto (browser state-changing routes are protected), required, or off - one enum here and in security.defaults rules alike.

idempotency.description: Idempotent replay for commands. A replayed key returns the stored response; a reused key with a different body is TQL-IDEM-4090. Documented in transactional-writes.md.

required.description: Whether the Idempotency-Key header is required on this command.

scope.description: The replay scope key (default: the route id).

ttl.description: How long a stored response replays (duration string, default 24h).

admission.description: Admission policy for this route: concurrency, rate limiting, and the execution lane. Documented in productivity.md (admission) and jobs.md (lanes).

maxInFlight.description: Maximum requests of this route in flight at once; excess is rejected.

scope.description: node (default) limits per runtime node; cluster coordinates through the shared lease store (TQL-YAML-1023).

lane.description: The execution lane this route runs on (tesseraql.lanes).

outbox.description: Transactional outbox event recorded with the command and delivered at-least-once after commit. Documented in notifications.md and messaging.md.

http.description: Named HTTP sources on a query route (docs/connectors.md, "HTTP sources"): each is a body-less GET against an external JSON API, executed through the outbound gateway (deny-by-default allowedHosts, named credentials, timeouts, circuit breaker) and composed with the SQL results in the response or view as <name>.rows / <name>.body. Query recipes only (TQL-YAML-1022).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL; config placeholders resolve. The host must be in tesseraql.http.outbound.allowedHosts (TQL-SEC-4070).

query.description: Query-string bindings, each an expression over the execution context.

select.description: Dotted path into the response JSON naming the rows array or object the source exposes.

onError.description: fail (default) or empty: the source degrades to zero rows and the page still renders.

cache.description: Declarative HTTP caching for query responses (docs/response-shaping.md): Cache-Control from maxAge/visibility (private default; public lints onto auth: public only) and a content ETag answering If-None-Match with 304. Query recipes only (TQL-YAML-1025).

maxAge.description: How long a client may reuse the response (duration string such as 30s or 5m).

etag.description: Hash the rendered body and answer If-None-Match with 304 (default true).

emit.description: Topic(s) broadcast to live views after this command commits (docs/realtime.md). A name is lowercase dot/dash-separated segments; the event carries the topic name only, never data.

refreshOn.description: List, detail, and dashboard views (not forms): refetch this view's refresh region whenever a command emits this topic (docs/realtime.md).

datasource.description: The named connector under tesseraql.datasources the route's SQL runs on, defaulting to main. The name must be declared (TQL-YAML-1035); a non-main route cannot declare notify:/publish:/outbox: or sequence allocation - they ride the main connector (TQL-YAML-1036).

queries.description: Additional named queries executed after sql, each bound into the execution context under its name.

validate.description: Declarative validation rules keyed by rule id. A rule declares exactly one of rule: (a cross-field expression), file: (validation SQL), or use: (a shared rule declared under rules/). Honored on command-json, query-json and webhook routes, on queue consumers, and on MCP tools.

rule.description: A cross-field expression that must hold.

file.description: Validation SQL returning one row per violation; must be a SELECT, and runs inside the command's transaction.

use.description: Name of a shared rule declared under rules/. The reference supplies params: matching the rule's binds: contract, plus its own field:/when:/code:/message:.

params.description: Binds for a SQL rule, as dotted source expressions.

field.description: The input the violation is reported against.

when.description: Guard expression; the rule is skipped when it is falsy.

decide.description: Decision-table references keyed by alias, evaluated once per operation before the validate: rules; outputs publish as decision.<alias>.<output> for SQL binds and directives. Documented in decision-tables.md.

use.description: Name of a decision declared under decisions/.

params.description: Wiring of each decision input to a request-context expression (params.total, principal.orgUnit, "principal.role == 'officer'").

effectiveAt.description: Reference instant of a dated table-backed decision's effective: window - audit.now unless wired to a document date (params.postingDate).

notify.description: Notifications enqueued with the command on the transactional outbox, keyed by notification id; each entry names its channel: (a workflow reminder is the separate reminders: key). Documented in notifications.md.

errors.description: Per-route error mapping: constraint codes and statuses onto response fields and messages. Documented in declarative-validation.md.

import.description: file-import parsing and column-to-bind mapping (headerRow, startRow, columns, onError: rollback|skip). Documented in file-transfers.md.

export.description: query-export / file-export output: format (csv, excel, pdf), filename, columns with headers and format patterns, locale/timezone. Documented in file-transfers.md.

provider.description: A verifier under tesseraql.connectors.webhooks (an unknown provider fails the build).

pagination.description: Declarative pagination: the framework appends the dialect clause; authored SQL carries no LIMIT/FETCH.

view.description: The id of a *.view.yml document (exclusive with template:).

shell.description: Shell negotiation: auto (default) serves the bare #page-content region to htmx requests and the shell-wrapped page to direct navigation; always wraps unconditionally; never declares an htmx-only region endpoint.

views.description: View ids whose models a template: route binds; each renders into views['<id>'] for the template to insert (illegal alongside view:).

rotate.description: Re-issue the caller's session cookie in place on success: a fresh id and CSRF token, the old id invalidated before the response leaves. Declare on routes that elevate the session (confirming an MFA enrollment); bearer or public callers are untouched.

view.description: Declarative view documents (kind: view): list | form | detail | dashboard.

trigger.description: How a job starts (kind: job): a schedule, or a directory/SFTP/FTPS poll source feeding the import: pipeline. Documented in jobs.md and connectors.md.

cron.description: A Quartz cron expression; firings are claimed cluster-wide so one node runs each.

fixedDelay.description: A period (duration string, e.g. 5m); mutually exclusive with cron.

calendar.description: A business-day calendar declared under calendars/ - the cron says when to consider a firing, the calendar says whether it counts. Documented in jobs.md.

runOn.description: Which considered firings count under the calendar (default business-day); mutually exclusive with dayOfMonth.

dayOfMonth.description: The shifted nominal-day rule: fire on this day of month, or its shifted business day when it is not one - and the run's business date is the nominal date. Rounds down to the month's last day. Documented in jobs.md.

shift.description: Where a non-business nominal day moves (default next-business-day); requires dayOfMonth.

transport.description: local (default) polls a directory under connectors.poll.allowedPaths; sftp/ftps poll a remote host in connectors.poll.allowedHosts.

path.description: The polled directory. A local path must sit under a declared allowedPaths root. A remote path with a leading slash is absolute on the server; without one it resolves against the credential's login home.

credential.description: A named credential under tesseraql.connectors.poll.credentials (required for remote sources).

move.description: Relative directory for processed files (default .done). Plain names only - no paths or placeholders.

moveFailed.description: Relative directory for failed files (default .error). Plain names only.

after.description: Light chaining: fire when the named job's execution completes successfully in the same app, carrying its business date. Documented in jobs.md.

overlap.description: What a firing does while the previous execution still runs (kind: job): skip (default) records a SKIPPED execution naming the running one; concurrent runs anyway - declare it only for jobs that are safe to overlap. Documented in jobs.md.

sla.description: Deadline expectations a periodic managed check alerts on through the alerts channel (kind: job) - alert-only, nothing is killed. Documented in jobs.md.

completeBy.description: Wall-clock time (HH:mm) by which a day's run must have completed for that business date.

runningLongerThan.description: A duration (e.g. 2h) beyond which a still-running execution raises the alert.

perTenant.description: Run this job once per configured tenant, each on its own datasource and tenant context (kind: job). Documented in multi-tenancy.md.

pipeline.description: A batch-pipeline job's ordered steps (exactly one of sql, notify, httpCall, chunk, export, or push per step), each publishing its result to the step context. Documented in jobs.md.

domain.description: Name of a field domain declared under domains/; its type, bounds, pattern, format, enum, classification and mask merge in, and the keys declared here win. Operational keys (required, requiredWhen, default, writable) stay route-local.

pattern.description: Anchored regular expression (TQL-YAML-1012 when it does not compile).

format.description: string: email|uuid|url; date/number: a parse pattern.

widget.description: Presentation hint (docs/declarative-views.md): the form widget this field renders as, declared once on a domain; a per-view fields: override wins. Never part of the HTTP contract.

file.description: A colocated 2-way SQL file (must exist; TQL-SQL-2103).

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-binding SQL statement timeout override; 0 disables. Default: tesseraql.sql.timeoutSeconds, else 30s.

datasource.description: The named connector this read binding runs on, overriding the route's connector. A step inside a transactional pipeline cannot pick its own connector (TQL-YAML-1037).

when.description: Guard expression on a command step: a falsy guard skips the step, recording steps.<name>.skipped. The declared branch point for decision.* outputs (docs decision-tables); not legal on the single-statement sql: form.

rowCount.description: The exact number of rows the statement must affect (rows is a list of records everywhere else).

when.description: A whitelist-only expression over the execution context; the first matching entry wins.

status.description: The HTTP status to answer when the expression is truthy.
